text:
### 2. Fee Disputes  
**Example:** Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee  
**Investigation:**
- Review terms & conditions
- Check if fee applied correctly
- Assess if fee disclosed clearly
- Review customer history  
**Resolution:**
- If fee applied correctly per T&Cs: Explain and decline reversal
- If fee error: Reverse charge + interest
- If unclear T&Cs: Refund + apology

raw_entities.name: Fee Disputes Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the investigation and resolution of customer complaints regarding unexpected charges, overdraft fees, and card replacement fees. Establishes investigation procedures including review of terms and conditions, fee application accuracy, and disclosure clarity, with resolution pathways based on investigation findings.
context: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee
If fee applied correctly per T&Cs: Explain and decline reversal

raw_entities.name: Fee Dispute Investigation Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to investigate fee disputes by reviewing terms and conditions, verifying correct fee application, assessing clarity of fee disclosure, and reviewing customer account history.

raw_entities.name: Fee Dispute Resolution - Correct Application
raw_entities.description: When investigation confirms fee was applied correctly per terms and conditions, the bank must explain the fee to the customer and decline reversal.
context: If fee applied correctly per T&Cs: Explain and decline reversal

raw_entities.name: Fee Dispute Resolution - Error Correction
raw_entities.description: When investigation identifies a fee application error, the bank must reverse the charge and provide interest compensation to the customer.
context: If fee error: Reverse charge + interest

raw_entities.name: Fee Dispute Resolution - Unclear Terms
raw_entities.description: When investigation determines that terms and conditions were unclear regarding fee disclosure, the bank must refund the charge and provide an apology to the customer.

properties.risk_definition: A fee charged to a customer that was not anticipated or clearly communicated
examples: Charges not mentioned in terms and conditions
properties.required_response: Investigate whether charge was applied correctly and disclosed clearly; resolve based on findings

properties.risk_definition: Fees charged when a customer's account balance falls below zero
examples: Overdraft charges applied to accounts that exceeded agreed limits
properties.required_response: Verify fee was applied correctly per terms and conditions; reverse if error or terms were unclear

properties.risk_definition: Fees charged for replacing a damaged, lost, or expired card
examples: Card replacement charges disputed by customers
properties.required_response: Confirm fee was disclosed and applied correctly; reverse if error or terms were unclear

evidence_required: copy of applicable terms and conditions
